title: The use of a convolutional neural network to automate radiologic scoring of computed tomography of paranasal sinuses.
summary: A convolutional network segmented paranasal-sinus CT scans and automated Lund–Mackay scoring against manual annotations; this is a bounded imaging-method evaluation.
